enabled.title: Enable Viewer Lobby
enabled.description: Turn on viewer chat commands and creator controls after setup is complete.

platforms.title: Platforms allowed to join
platforms.description: Only viewers chatting on checked platforms can use the lobby commands.

commandPrefix.title: Command prefix
commandPrefix.description: The one character viewers type before every lobby command.

joinCommand.title: Join command
joinCommand.description: A viewer types this command to enter the waiting list.

leaveCommand.title: Leave command
leaveCommand.description: A viewer types this command to remove only their own entry.

positionCommand.title: Position command
positionCommand.description: Shows the invoking viewer's current waiting position.

queueCommand.title: Queue summary command
queueCommand.description: Shows whether the lobby is open and how many viewers are waiting.

maximumEntries.title: Maximum waiting viewers
maximumEntries.description: New joins stop at this private queue limit.

maximumVisibleEntries.title: Viewers shown on overlay
maximumVisibleEntries.description: Limits the public browser source while the full private queue remains available.

allowGamertag.title: Allow an optional gamertag after !join
allowGamertag.description: When enabled, viewers can type !join followed by a gamertag.

showGamertags.title: Show gamertags on the public overlay
showGamertags.description: Off is safer; gamertags remain private unless this is explicitly enabled.

showPlatforms.title: Show platform names on the overlay
showPlatforms.description: Displays Twitch, YouTube, Kick, or TikTok beside each visible viewer.

offlinePolicy.title: When the final live platform ends
offlinePolicy.description: Close keeps the queue for later; Clear permanently removes every entry.

backgroundMode.title: Overlay background
backgroundMode.description: Glass is recommended; None leaves only text visible.

backgroundColor.title: Background color
backgroundColor.description: Six-digit hexadecimal color used behind the queue.

backgroundOpacity.title: Background opacity
backgroundOpacity.description: 0 is transparent and 1 is fully opaque.

textColor.title: Text color
textColor.description: Choose a high-contrast color for readable names and queue details.

ignoredUsers.title: Ignored viewers/bots
ignoredUsers.description: Preloaded with common service bots; add or remove exact login names as needed.
